Explore the daily demand shape

Hourly mean power for the current eligible owner pool. Change the charging context or saved power case.

Each curve averages the study-period mean profiles across replicates. The band, available for the reduced case, describes variation between those replicate means; it is not a confidence band or a range of individual daily peaks.

Inspect hourly values

Daily energy by charging context

T1–T4 are charging contexts. These results have not been scaled to districts or the national EV fleet.

Compare public charging power assumptions

Both cases use verified matching candidate draws. Power changes can alter charging duration, owner-overlap decisions and energy crossing the study boundaries.

Rated minus reduced: hourly mean power

Positive values mean more power in the rated case at that hour. The band is P05–P95 of paired replicate mean-profile differences. Rated power is not an upper bound on every aggregate hourly value.

Paired comparison by context

Rejections are proposed starts blocked by the owner-overlap rule; they are not measured charger failures. Percentages below pool study starts across all replicates.

Inspect Monte Carlo mean precision

MCSE estimates simulation sampling uncertainty under the fixed synthetic inputs. It does not measure real-world forecasting accuracy.

Daily-energy MCSE as replicates are added

MCSE = sample standard deviation / √replicates. Checkpoints reuse nested prefixes of the same batch. This is a precision diagnostic; no formal convergence threshold was set.

Checkpoint estimates

Trace an owner through one replicate

Charging intervals and rejected proposed starts

Bars are accepted charging intervals, clipped to the displayed horizon. Crosses mark rejected proposed starts. Day 0 is the first study day. Carry-in charging can contribute study energy even when its start occurred during warm-up.

Owner inputs and sampled candidate rates

Inspect the saved owner parameter record (reduced case) 












Drawn energy is the proposal's full-session energy. Rejected proposals receive no allocated energy. Study-energy totals include accepted carry-in charging.









Explain which inputs can enter the simulator


Eligibility requires resolved bounds and consistent usable parameters. The ready pool is a completeness-selected subset; its composition cannot be extrapolated to Sri Lankan EV owners.








First recorded deferral reasons




One first reason per deferred owner is shown here. The separate readiness review detects additional issues, so these counts are not a complete issue inventory.






Implemented data-to-demand path




1. PrepareSurvey tables and quality checks


2. EncodeAnswers into bounded features


3. ReviewOwner readiness and parameters


4. SimulateCandidate starts, power and duration


5. ScheduleChronological owner-overlap checks


6. AuditHourly energy and replicate summaries




Current energy-duration rule: active hours = drawn kWh / effective average kW. The engine does not yet track driving trips, battery SOC trajectories or station queues.


Next data milestone: collect real responses, rerun preparation and readiness checks, review parameter assumptions, and assess simulated results against available independent observations. No trained forecasting model is included in this demo.
